title: Suggest walk areas for a list's audience
body:
Canvassers keep asking for help splitting a list into turfs. Today the door knocking create flow makes them draw every turf by hand on the map, and for a list of a few thousand doors that is the step where people give up.

This adds `POST /v1/contacts/walk-areas`, which takes the same draft filter payload as `POST /v1/contacts/points` plus a `doorsPerArea` (10 to 200, default 60, about a two-hour shift) and returns suggested walk areas: each with a center, its household and people counts, and a bbox the map can draw. The webapp change to offer these as one-click turfs comes in a follow-up.

How it works:
- Reads the whole audience from the warehouse through `evaluatePoints`, rooftop-geocoded only like a turf's doors, up to 50,000 people (the evaluate contract's ceiling) rather than the map's 10,000 dots, so the areas cover the full list. `truncated` is passed through when the audience is bigger.
- Groups residents into households by unit key, then runs k-means with k sized from `doorsPerArea`, seeded deterministically along a west-to-east sweep so the same list always gets the same areas. Distances are on a plane scaled by the mean latitude, which is plenty accurate inside one district.
- Same Pro and district gates as `points`, and the same empty-audience short circuit.

I tested it against a small Serve district in dev (about 1,800 households): the whole request comes back in about 40ms, and the clustering itself is a few ms. The areas look right on the map.

Tests: unit tests for the clustering (households, splitting neighborhoods, sizing, bbox) and route tests through the harness for the gates, the read and the response. The response shape is `WalkAreasResponseSchema` in contracts, and the route is documented in `src/contacts/docs/http-surface.md`.
author: delegate-eval

@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+import { z } from 'zod'
+import { BboxSchema } from '../shared/Bbox.schema'
+
+// Households per suggested area. Sixty is about a two-hour shift for one
+// canvasser; the bounds keep an area walkable in an afternoon.
+export const WALK_AREA_MIN_DOORS = 10
+export const WALK_AREA_MAX_DOORS = 200
+export const WALK_AREA_DEFAULT_DOORS = 60
+
+export const WalkAreaSchema = z.object({
+  centerLat: z.number().min(-90).max(90),
+  centerLng: z.number().min(-180).max(180),
+  households: z.number().int().positive(),
+  people: z.number().int().positive(),
+  bbox: BboxSchema,
+})
+export type WalkArea = z.infer<typeof WalkAreaSchema>
+
+// `truncated` when the audience had more people than one read returns; the
+// areas then cover only the people that came back.
+export const WalkAreasResponseSchema = z.object({
+  areas: z.array(WalkAreaSchema),
+  truncated: z.boolean(),
+})
+export type WalkAreasResponse = z.infer<typeof WalkAreasResponseSchema>

+| `POST /v1/contacts/walk-areas`                                                         | Suggested canvassing turfs for a list still being built: the `points` draft payload plus `doorsPerArea` (10 to 200, default 60). Each area has its center, households, people and bbox. Same Pro and district gates as `points`; `truncated` when the audience passed the cap                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
 | `GET /v1/campaigns/mine/recommended-lists/:variant/download` (recommendedLists module) | The saved-list CSV for a recommendation not saved yet: resolves the variant's global universe, then `ContactsService.downloadFilter` — `downloadContacts` fed an inline filter, always individual voters (`docs/features/recommended-lists.md`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
 | `POST /v1/contacts/list-detail`                                                        | The same demographics + reachability for an UNSAVED filter — the body is the count endpoint's inline filter (`CountContactsDTO`), run through the same resolution. `outreachHistory` is always `[]`: nothing has been sent to a list that does not exist. Backs the voter data page's recommended-list detail sheet (`docs/features/recommended-lists.md`). Aggregates only, so open to a free campaign like `count`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
 | `GET /v1/contacts/list-detail`                                                         | Saved-segment detail (`segment` param): demographics, reachable-by-channel (sms/robocall/phoneBanking/doorKnocking/polls), outreach history. Aggregates only, so open to a free campaign like `count` (the outreach audience step prices a saved list off it before the upgrade). Omitting `segment` returns the universe row's detail instead — the whole unfiltered district, `outreachHistory` always `[]` (ENG-10778). `segment=civicPanel` is Serve's built-in panel list: the `civicPanelMember` filter's figures (so the same 400 for a non-`eo-` org), and as `outreachHistory` the office's sent outreaches that reached a current member (see "The panel as a whole"). +import { z } from 'zod'
+import { createZodDto } from 'nestjs-zod'
+import {
+  WALK_AREA_DEFAULT_DOORS,
+  WALK_AREA_MAX_DOORS,
+  WALK_AREA_MIN_DOORS,
+} from '@goodparty_org/contracts'
+import { voterFilterBaseSchema } from '@/shared/schemas/voterFilterBase.schema'
+
+// The same unsaved-draft filter grammar as `POST /v1/contacts/points`, so
+// the areas are drawn over exactly the dots the draw step shows.
+const walkAreasContactsSchema = z
+  .object({
+    filters: voterFilterBaseSchema,
+    doorsPerArea: z
+      .number()
+      .int()
+      .min(WALK_AREA_MIN_DOORS)
+      .max(WALK_AREA_MAX_DOORS)
+      .default(WALK_AREA_DEFAULT_DOORS),
+  })
+  .strict()
+
+export class WalkAreasContactsDTO extends createZodDto(
+  walkAreasContactsSchema,
+) {}

+

@@ -1593,6 +1599,54 @@ export class ContactsService {

   }
 
+  // The audience split into walkable areas of about `doorsPerArea`
+  // households each, for the door knocking create flow to offer as turfs.
+  // Same draft payload and gates as filterPoints, but rooftop-geocoded only,
+  // like a turf's doors, so every household in an area is one a route can
+  // reach.
+  async suggestWalkAreas(
+    { filters: filterInput, doorsPerArea }: WalkAreasContactsDTO,
+    organization: Organization,
+  ): Promise<WalkAreasResponse> {
+    if (!(await this.isProAccess(organization))) {
+      throw new ForbiddenException(PRO_FILTERING_REQUIRED_MESSAGE)
+    }
+
+    const resolved = await this.resolveSavedFilterForQuery(
+      organization,
+      filterInput,
+    )
+    if (resolved.empty) {
+      return { areas: [], truncated: false }
+    }
+
+    return this.withOrgDistrictResolution(
+      organization,
+      async ({ districtId, dataset }) => {
+        const { people, truncated } =
+          await this.voterDoorKnockingService.evaluatePoints(
+            DoorKnockingEvaluateDTO.create({
+              districtId,
+              bbox: DISTRICT_WIDE_BBOX,
+              filters: resolved.filters,
+              idOverrides: resolved.idOverrides,
+              contactsMadeIdOverrides: resolved.contactsMadeIdOverrides,
+              affinityColumn: await this.affinityColumnFor(
+                organization,
+                resolved.filters,
+              ),
+              maxPeople: WALK_AREAS_MAX_PEOPLE,
+            }),
+            dataset,
+          )
+        return {
+          areas: clusterWalkAreas(people, doorsPerArea),
+          truncated,
+        }
+      },
+    )
+  }
+
   // Where a known set of people live, for a map of who answered. Scoped to
   // the org's district like every other people read, so an id from another
   // district simply has no point.

+import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto'
+import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { DoorKnockingEvaluateResponse } from '@goodparty_org/contracts'
+import { useTestService } from '@/test-service'
+import { VoterDoorKnockingService } from '@/peopleDb/services/voterDoorKnocking.service'
+
+const service = useTestService()
+
+const ORG_SLUG_HEADER = 'X-Organization-Slug'
+
+const person = (lng: number, lat: number, addressKey = `${lng}|${lat}`) => ({
+  id: randomUUID(),
+  firstName: 'Ada',
+  lastName: 'Lovelace',
+  lat,
+  lng,
+  addressKey,
+  displayAddress: '1 Main St',
+})
+
+describe('POST /v1/contacts/walk-areas', () => {
+  const setupServeOrg = async (
+    suffix: string,
+    data: { overrideDistrictId?: string } = {
+      overrideDistrictId: randomUUID(),
+    },
+  ) => {
+    const slug = `eo-walk-areas-${suffix}-${Date.now()}`
+    await service.prisma.organization.create({
+      data: { slug, ownerId: service.user.id, ...data },
+    })
+    return slug
+  }
+
+  const spyOnEvaluatePoints = (
+    people: DoorKnockingEvaluateResponse['people'],
+    truncated = false,
+  ) =>
+    vi
+      .spyOn(service.app.get(VoterDoorKnockingService), 'evaluatePoints')
+      .mockResolvedValue({ people, truncated })
+
+  const walkAreas = (slug: string, body: Record<string, unknown>) =>
+    service.client.post('/v1/contacts/walk-areas', body, {
+      headers: { [ORG_SLUG_HEADER]: slug },
+    })
+
+  it('403s for a non-pro organization without querying people-db', async () => {
+    const slug = `campaign-walk-areas-nonpro-${Date.now()}`
+    await service.prisma.organization.create({
+      data: { slug, ownerId: service.user.id },
+    })
+    const spy = spyOnEvaluatePoints([])
+
+    const response = await walkAreas(slug, { filters: { genderMale: true } })
+
+    expect(response.status).toBe(403)
+    expect(spy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+  })
+
+  it('400s with VOTER_DATA_UNAVAILABLE when the org resolves no district', async () => {
+    const slug = await setupServeOrg('no-district', {})
+    const spy = spyOnEvaluatePoints([])
+
+    const response = await walkAreas(slug, { filters: { genderMale: true } })
+
+    expect(response.status).toBe(400)
+    expect(response.data).toEqual(
+      expect.objectContaining({ errorCode: 'VOTER_DATA_UNAVAILABLE' }),
+    )
+    expect(spy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+  })
+
+  it('400s on a doorsPerArea outside the walkable range', async () => {
+    const slug = await setupServeOrg('doors-range')
+    const spy = spyOnEvaluatePoints([])
+
+    const response = await walkAreas(slug, {
+      filters: { genderMale: true },
+      doorsPerArea: 5,
+    })
+
+    expect(response.status).toBe(400)
+    expect(spy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+  })
+
+  it('returns no areas, without querying, when the filters match nobody', async () => {
+    const slug = await setupServeOrg('audience-empty')
+    const spy = spyOnEvaluatePoints([person(0.5, 0.5)])
+
+    const response = await walkAreas(slug, {
+      filters: {
+        activityConditions: [{ outreachType: 'doorKnocking', actions: [] }],
+      },
+    })
+
+    expect(response.status).toBe(201)
+    expect(response.data).toEqual({ areas: [], truncated: false })
+    expect(spy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+  })
+
+  it('reads the whole audience, rooftop-geocoded only', async () => {
+    const slug = await setupServeOrg('whole-audience')
+    const spy = spyOnEvaluatePoints([])
+
+    await walkAreas(slug, { filters: { genderFemale: true } })
+
+    const [dto, , opts] = spy.mock.calls[0] ?? []
+    expect(dto?.maxPeople).toBe(50_000)
+    expect(JSON.stringify(dto?.filters)).toContain('gender')
+    expect(opts?.requireRooftopAccuracy).not.toBe(false)
+  })
+
+  it('splits the audience into areas of about doorsPerArea households', async () => {
+    const slug = await setupServeOrg('split')
+    spyOnEvaluatePoints([
+      ...Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, index) =>
+        person(-85.66 + index * 0.0002, 42.96),
+      ),
+      ...Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, index) =>
+        person(-85.7 + index * 0.0002, 42.99),
+      ),
+    ])
+
+    const response = await walkAreas(slug, {
+      filters: { genderMale: true },
+      doorsPerArea: 20,
+    })
+
+    expect(response.status).toBe(201)
+    expect(response.data.truncated).toBe(false)
+    expect(response.data.areas).toHaveLength(2)
+    expect(
+      response.data.areas.map(
+        (area: { households: number }) => area.households,
+      ),
+    ).toEqual([20, 20])
+  })
+
+  it('passes the truncation flag through', async () => {
+    const slug = await setupServeOrg('truncated')
+    spyOnEvaluatePoints([person(0.5, 0.5)], true)
+
+    const response = await walkAreas(slug, { filters: { genderMale: true } })
+
+    expect(response.status).toBe(201)
+    expect(response.data.truncated).toBe(true)
+  })
+})

@@ -0,0 +1,65 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
+import { clusterWalkAreas } from './walkAreas.util'
+
+// A row of `count` doors along one street, about 15m apart.
+const street = (lat: number, lng: number, count: number, prefix: string) =>
+  Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => ({
+    lat,
+    lng: lng + index * 0.0002,
+    addressKey: `${prefix}-${index}`,
+  }))
+
+describe('clusterWalkAreas', () => {
+  it('returns no areas for no people', () => {
+    expect(clusterWalkAreas([], 60)).toEqual([])
+  })
+
+  it('counts a household once however many people live there', () => {
+    const people = [
+      { lat: 42.96, lng: -85.66, addressKey: 'a' },
+      { lat: 42.96, lng: -85.66, addressKey: 'a' },
+      { lat: 42.96, lng: -85.6598, addressKey: 'b' },
+    ]
+
+    expect(clusterWalkAreas(people, 60)).toEqual([
+      expect.objectContaining({ households: 2, people: 3 }),
+    ])
+  })
+
+  it('splits two neighborhoods apart', () => {
+    const people = [
+      ...street(42.96, -85.66, 30, 'east'),
+      ...street(42.99, -85.7, 30, 'west'),
+    ]
+
+    const areas = clusterWalkAreas(people, 30)
+
+    expect(areas).toHaveLength(2)
+    expect(areas.map((area) => area.households)).toEqual([30, 30])
+    const lats = areas.map((area) => area.centerLat).sort((a, b) => a - b)
+    expect(lats[0]).toBeCloseTo(42.96)
+    expect(lats[1]).toBeCloseTo(42.99)
+  })
+
+  it('sizes the areas from doorsPerArea', () => {
+    const people = street(42.96, -85.66, 120, 'main')
+
+    const areas = clusterWalkAreas(people, 40)
+
+    expect(areas).toHaveLength(3)
+    expect(areas.reduce((sum, area) => sum + area.households, 0)).toBe(120)
+  })
+
+  it('bounds each area by its households', () => {
+    const people = street(42.96, -85.66, 10, 'main')
+
+    const [area] = clusterWalkAreas(people, 60)
+
+    expect(area?.bbox).toEqual({
+      minLat: 42.96,
+      maxLat: 42.96,
+      minLng: -85.66,
+      maxLng: expect.closeTo(-85.6582),
+    })
+  })
+})
diff --git a/packages/gp-api/src/contacts/utils/walkAreas.util.ts b/packages/gp-api/src/contacts/utils/walkAreas.util.ts

index 0000000000..ab2fc6ce2b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/gp-api/src/contacts/utils/walkAreas.util.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,132 @@
+import type { WalkArea } from '@goodparty_org/contracts'
+
+type WalkAreaPerson = { lat: number; lng: number; addressKey: string }
+
+type Household = { lat: number; lng: number; people: number }
+
+type Center = { lat: number; lng: number }
+
+const MAX_ITERATIONS = 25
+
+// Residents of one address share a unit key; the first resident's position
+// stands for the door.
+const toHouseholds = (people: WalkAreaPerson[]): Household[] => {
+  const byAddress = new Map<string, Household>()
+  for (const person of people) {
+    const household = byAddress.get(person.addressKey)
+    if (household) {
+      household.people += 1
+    } else {
+      byAddress.set(person.addressKey, {
+        lat: person.lat,
+        lng: person.lng,
+        people: 1,
+      })
+    }
+  }
+  return [...byAddress.values()]
+}
+
+// Seeds spread evenly along a west-to-east sweep, so the same audience
+// always comes back as the same areas.
+const seedCenters = (households: Household[], count: number): Center[] => {
+  const sorted = [...households].sort((a, b) => a.lng - b.lng || a.lat - b.lat)
+  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => {
+    const seed = sorted[Math.floor(((index + 0.5) * sorted.length) / count)]!
+    return { lat: seed.lat, lng: seed.lng }
+  })
+}
+
+// k-means over the households, with k sized so each area holds about
+// `doorsPerArea` doors. Distances are on a plane scaled by the audience's
+// mean latitude, which is exact enough inside one district.
+export const clusterWalkAreas = (
+  people: WalkAreaPerson[],
+  doorsPerArea: number,
+): WalkArea[] => {
+  const households = toHouseholds(people)
+  if (households.length === 0) return []
+
+  const meanLat =
+    households.reduce((sum, household) => sum + household.lat, 0) /
+    households.length
+  const lngScale = Math.cos((meanLat * Math.PI) / 180)
+  const distance = (a: Center, b: Center): number =>
+    ((a.lng - b.lng) * lngScale) ** 2 + (a.lat - b.lat) ** 2
+
+  const count = Math.ceil(households.length / doorsPerArea)
+  let centers = seedCenters(households, count)
+  const assignment = new Array<number>(households.length).fill(-1)
+
+  for (let iteration = 0; iteration < MAX_ITERATIONS; iteration++) {
+    let moved = false
+    households.forEach((household, index) => {
+      let nearest = 0
+      let nearestDistance = Infinity
+      centers.forEach((center, centerIndex) => {
+        const d = distance(household, center)
+        if (d < nearestDistance) {
+          nearest = centerIndex
+          nearestDistance = d
+        }
+      })
+      if (assignment[index] !== nearest) {
+        assignment[index] = nearest
+        moved = true
+      }
+    })
+    if (!moved) break
+
+    const sums = centers.map(() => ({ lat: 0, lng: 0, count: 0 }))
+    households.forEach((household, index) => {
+      const sum = sums[assignment[index]!]!
+      sum.lat += household.lat
+      sum.lng += household.lng
+      sum.count += 1
+    })
+    centers = centers.map((center, centerIndex) => {
+      const sum = sums[centerIndex]!
+      return sum.count === 0
+        ? center
+        : { lat: sum.lat / sum.count, lng: sum.lng / sum.count }
+    })
+  }
+
+  const areas = centers.map(() => ({
+    households: 0,
+    people: 0,
+    lat: 0,
+    lng: 0,
+    minLat: Infinity,
+    maxLat: -Infinity,
+    minLng: Infinity,
+    maxLng: -Infinity,
+  }))
+  households.forEach((household, index) => {
+    const area = areas[assignment[index]!]!
+    area.households += 1
+    area.people += household.people
+    area.lat += household.lat
+    area.lng += household.lng
+    area.minLat = Math.min(area.minLat, household.lat)
+    area.maxLat = Math.max(area.maxLat, household.lat)
+    area.minLng = Math.min(area.minLng, household.lng)
+    area.maxLng = Math.max(area.maxLng, household.lng)
+  })
+
+  return areas
+    .filter((area) => area.households > 0)
+    .map((area) => ({
+      centerLat: area.lat / area.households,
+      centerLng: area.lng / area.households,
+      households: area.households,
+      people: area.people,
+      bbox: {
+        minLat: area.minLat,
+        maxLat: area.maxLat,
+        minLng: area.minLng,
+        maxLng: area.maxLng,
+      },
+    }))
+    .sort((a, b) => b.households - a.households)
+}
